evidence.passage:
Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and
its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36
months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first
policy with insurer.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages
rules.requirement: PED treatment and direct complications have a 36-month continuous-coverage wait from first inception.

evidence.passage:

a fresh to the extent of sum insured increase.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages
rules.requirement: PED exclusion applies afresh only to the increased sum-insured portion.

evidence.passage:
If the Insured Person is continuously covered without any break as
defined under the portability norms of the extant IRDAI (Health
Insurance) Regulations, then waiting period for the same would be
reduced to the extent of prior coverage.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages

evidence.passage:

pre-existing disease is subject to the same being declared at the time
of application and accepted by Insurer.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages

evidence.passage:
Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/
treatments and its direct complications shall be excluded until the
expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage, as may be the case after
the date of inception of the first policy with the Company. This
exclusion shall not beapplicable for claims arising due to an accident.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages
rules.requirement: Listed conditions, procedures and complications have a 24-month wait with an accident exception.

evidence.passage:
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days
from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded
except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are
covered.

rules.inventoried_by: Codex: original PDF pages 26, 34 and 36 visually inspected; native text checked against those pages
rules.requirement: Illness expenses within 30 days of first commencement are excluded; covered accident claims are excepted.

evidence.passage:

Continuous Coverage for more than twelve months.

evidence.passage:

assessed accordingly.

of such renewal.
